title: First disjoint extension of the six recovered prime-curve seed streams
candidate_rule: srand48(timestamp), 20 successive top bytes per 1-based block; ANSI X9.62 SHA-1 coefficient; a=-3; p=3 mod 4 exponentiation root or arbitrary P-224 isomorphic root
scope: Only the 1,024 blocks immediately after each stream's last published seed; no timestamp search, other field primes, altered RNG consumption, or hidden-property predicate
controls: Regenerate the last published seed and verify its published coefficient and field; check count outputs for candidate count and unique ordinals; preserve all early aborts and errors
inference_policy: Descriptive search only. A modern accepted curve is not evidence that the 1997 program evaluated or would have published it. No conclusion about a hidden criterion or ECDLP advantage follows from this slice.
